decision.author: ezyang
decision.body:
ScriptObject is not guaranteed to not have memory footprint, it can hold tensors internally. Test is insufficient, need to do an actual full test, not a unit test of `_size_of`. Some design consideration here necessary; need a way to probe a fake script object for size. @angelayi @zou3519 do you have some guidance on the API design here?

If need unblock, I could be persuaded to add a config flag "assume all script objects are zero size" which you can unblock your flow on.
